verdict.rationale: Community evidence shows Jira supports scripted bulk actions via its REST API and JQL queries (jira-comm-11, jira-comm-14) and native multi-select/drag-drop in list views (jira-comm-4), but there is no direct documentation of a dedicated bulk-operations feature, and users report UI reliability issues (crashes, data loss, slow loading) that would hinder large-scale bulk actions (jira-comm-7, jira-comm-10).
